summary: Horizon Quantum Holdings Ltd., a Singapore-based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting the appointment of Ms. Qian Yi Amanda Chew as Chief Product Officer, effective August 17, 2026. Ms. Chew, who joined the company in 2020 and most recently served as Vice President of Product, will transition to her new role after the effective date; her background includes prior positions at Microsoft. The filing is a routine management appointment disclosure, not a special situation, and no terms or transaction details are provided. The report is incorporated by reference into the company's Form S-8 registration statement.
